newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Group ends Truckaway operations.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Group ends Truckaway operations.

text.p: Morgan Group Inc said Thursday it substantially ended Truckaway Division operations as of May 1 after selling the unit's fixed assets in three transactions to Forest River, Dutchmen Folddown Division of Thor Industries Inc, and Jones Motor Group.

The sale, along with the anticipated sale of related real estate, collection of receivables and tax benefits, will result in a net cash benefit to the company in excess of $3.5 million over several years, it said, pointing out this is well above previous estimates.
More than $1.5 million has already been realized, Morgan Group said.
In contemplation of closing its capital-intensive Truckaway operation, Morgan noted, it had reported a special charge against its 1996 earnings.
The company said it will use part of the proceeds of asset sales to continue the purchase its Class A Common shares on the open market.

Management believes that the combination of eliminating the substantial losses registered last year in Truckaway, profitable contribution this year from Transit Homes, as well as overhead reduction and purchase of shares, should result in much improved operating and per share numbers for the company in 1997, Morgan Group said.
